settings.pdf_fallback_help: Claude, GPT and Gemini read PDFs natively — this only applies to models that don’t (GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, local models…). Text extraction is cheapest; page images cost more tokens and need a vision-capable model.

settings.context_bar_desc: A small meter showing how full the model’s context window is. Turn it off to show the same thing as a number instead.
settings.context_sub: How sessions spend tokens — attachment handling and long-history compaction.
settings.compaction_desc: Long sessions are compacted automatically: older turns are summarized so your study partner keeps working instead of running out of context. Your visible transcript is never changed — a small marker shows where compaction happened.
settings.compaction_cap_help: The cap makes very-large-context models compact early — quality and speed degrade well before their nominal limit.
settings.compaction_model_help: The summary is written by this model. The default follows whatever model the session is using.
settings.auto_approve_desc: Adds an Auto-approve option to the mode picker. In that mode, your session model reviews each action that would normally need approval and clears the routine ones; anything doubtful still asks you. It can never allow something the rules block. One extra model call per check, billed to your usage.
settings.auto_approve_shadow_desc: On any mode, the reviewer records what it would have decided next to your own choice — without changing anything. Lets you see how it would behave before trusting it. Also costs one model call per approval.

memory.section_sub: Your study partners can remember useful things about you between conversations. Everything they know is listed here.
memory.toggle_help: Lasting preferences you mention in chat get saved and used in future conversations — you'll see a small note each time, with one-tap Undo. Turning this off stops new saves; anything already below is still used until you delete it.
memory.on_msg: Details you share from future conversations will be remembered, so I can be more helpful over time.
memory.off_msg: I'll stop remembering new things about you. What I already know is kept and still used — delete anything below you'd rather I forget.
memory.wipe_confirm:
Delete everything that's been remembered about you?

This can't be undone. Conversations you already have open still know what they knew — new conversations start with a clean slate.
memory.wiped_msg: Everything I remembered has been deleted. New conversations start fresh; ones you already have open still know what they knew when they started.
memory.learned_help: Saved automatically from your conversations. Fix anything that's wrong — or delete it. Edits and deletions apply to new conversations; ones you already have open keep what they knew when they started.
memory.empty: Nothing yet. When you mention a lasting preference in chat — or say "remember that I'm weak on listening" — it will show up here.
memory.rules_help: Your study partners follow these in every conversation.
memory.rules_placeholder:
I use a screen reader — no tables, describe any image
Use DD-MM-YYYY for dates
memory.rules_saved: Saved — applies to new conversations. Ones you already have open keep the instructions they started with.
